title: F10: CSV export + OpenAPI export, Expenses page
milestone: M5 API + UI
labels: backend, frontend, contracts
---
## Goal
Confirmed expenses leave Budgie as a documented CSV (the file-exchange integration point), the spec documents that file, and the user can list, filter, open, delete and export expenses on `expenses.html`.

**Depends on:** F05, F06
**Built by:** `backend-dev` ∥ `frontend-dev`, after the contract-first wiki commit (decision 0024)

## Acceptance criteria
### Backend
- [ ] `GET /expenses/export.csv` replaces the 501 stub: `200`, `text/csv; charset=utf-8`, `Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="budgie-expenses_<from|all>_<to|all>.csv"`, `Cache-Control: no-store`
- [ ] A test parses the column table in `contracts/csv-export.md` and asserts the header row equals it, in order
- [ ] Table-driven unit tests for `domain/csv_export.py`: money with 2 decimals incl. negatives, `item_qty` without exponent or trailing zeros, `null` as an empty field, quoting of commas/quotes/newlines, the formula guard on string columns only (`-0.25` stays bare), an umlaut round-trip, CRLF
- [ ] API tests: only confirmed expenses, one row per item in position order, sorted by date then id; inclusive `from`/`to`; empty DB or `from > to` → header only; bad date → `422` on `query.from`; deposit and discount included; an un-confirmed expense disappears
- [ ] Built in memory, no file written, no row content logged
- [ ] The endpoint moves from `STUBS` to `BUILT` in `test_contract.py`; the route documents its columns and headers; `docs/openapi.json` regenerated and in sync

### Frontend
- [ ] `expenses.html` with filters (from, to, category, status, review status, type) kept in the URL; list with date, merchant, total, categories, status in words + icon, source label
- [ ] Open links to the review page; Delete asks in a `<dialog>` (mentions the photo for receipts), treats `404` as gone
- [ ] Download CSV via `api.download` for the current `from`/`to`, with the note that only confirmed expenses and only the date filter apply
- [ ] "Expenses" nav link on every page with `aria-current`
- [ ] `test_frontend_static.py` stays green (no sinks, `fetch` only in `api.js`, every path in the spec incl. `api.download`)

### Both
- [ ] `make check` passes; reviewer agent and `/code-review` ran; the student opened the CSV in a spreadsheet, deleted a photo receipt and a manual expense, and ran `make docker-check`
